text: Chapters 7 through 10 aren't four separate topics — they're four parts of one ongoing job: know what's happening, keep it healthy, fix what's slow, and don't have to watch it by hand.

Index maintenance and integrity checks belong on a schedule. CPU alerts, error-severity alerts, and regression detection belong always-on. Putting an always-on concern on a schedule means a real problem can sit unnoticed.

A nightly window for integrity checks and index maintenance, a weekly pass for backup verification, continuous alerts for thresholds and errors, and a human reviewing trends weekly — nobody's staring at a dashboard 24/7.
Chapter 10 is complete. Chapter 11 moves from Agent-based automation to Azure-native automation — CLI, PowerShell, and infrastructure as code.
